rules.name: Ambush
rules.description: May be set aside before deployment. At the start of any round after the first, may be deployed anywhere over 9” away from enemy units. Players alternate in placing Ambush units, starting with the player that activates next. Units that deploy via Ambush can’t seize or contest objectives on the round they deploy.

rules.name: Anti-Cover
rules.description: This weapon ignores Cover.

rules.name: AP
rules.description: AP

rules.name: Armor
rules.description: Counts as having Defense X+.

rules.name: Brute Courage
rules.description: If a unit where most models have this rule is Shaken at the beginning of the round, roll one die. On a 4+, it stops being Shaken.

rules.name: Defense
rules.description: This model gets +X to Defense rolls.

rules.name: Fear
rules.description: When in melee with this model, enemies count as having taken +X wounds when checking who won.

rules.name: Fearless
rules.description: When a unit where most models have this rule fails a Morale Test, roll one die. On a 4+ it counts as passed instead.

rules.name: Fearless Aura
rules.description: This model's unit and up to 2 friendly units picked before the start of the game get Fearless. If this model is killed, picked models that are deployed lose the rule.

rules.name: Fortified
rules.description: When units where most models have this rule take hits, those hits count as having AP(-1), to a min. of AP(0).

rules.name: Fortified Aura
rules.description: This model's unit and up to 2 friendly units picked before the start of the game get Fortified. If this model is killed, picked models that are deployed lose the rule.

rules.name: Repel Ambushers
rules.description: Enemy units using Ambush must be set up over 12" away from this model's unit.

rules.name: Scourge
rules.description: For each unmodified result of 1 to block hits, enemies count as having taken 2 extra wounds when checking who won melee, or if shooting wounds would trigger Morale Tests.

rules.name: Scout
rules.description: May be set aside before deployment. After all other units are deployed, may be deployed anywhere fully within 9” of their deployment zone, over 9” away from non-Scout enemy units. Players alternate in placing Scout units, starting with the player that activates next.

rules.name: Scout Aura
rules.description: This model's unit and up to 2 friendly units picked before the start of the game get Scout. If this model is killed, picked models that are deployed lose the rule.

rules.name: Spell Resistance
rules.description: When a unit where most models have this rule takes wounds, roll one die for each. If the wound was from a spell, then it is ignored on a 2+. If the wound was not from a spell, then it is ignored on a 6+ instead.

rules.name: Steadfast
rules.description: If a unit where most models have this rule is Shaken at the beginning of the round, roll one die. On a 4+, it stops being Shaken.

rules.name: Unpredictable
rules.description: When attacking, roll one die and apply one effect to all models with this rule: on a 1-3 they get AP(+1) on their weapons, and on a 4-6 they get +1 to hit rolls instead.

rules.name: Unpredictable Fighter
rules.description: When in melee, roll one die and apply one effect to all models with this rule: on a 1-3 they get AP(+1) on their weapons, and on a 4-6 they get +1 to hit rolls instead.

rules.name: Unpredictable Fighter Aura
rules.description: This model's unit and up to 2 friendly units picked before the start of the game get Unpredictable Fighter. If this model is killed, picked models that are deployed lose the rule.

rules.name: Unstoppable
rules.description: This weapon ignores Regeneration, and ignores all negative modifiers which are not from this model's special rules.

rules.name: Unstoppable when Shooting Aura
rules.description: This model's unit and up to 2 friendly units picked before the start of the game get Unstoppable on its weapons when shooting. If this model is killed, picked models that are deployed lose the rule.

rules.name: Unwieldy
rules.description: Strikes last when charging.

rules.name: Unwieldy Debuff
rules.description: Once per activation, before attacking, pick up to 3 enemy units within 18" in line of sight, which gets Unwieldy on its weapons in melee once (next time the effect would apply).

rules.name: Versatile Defense
rules.description: When a unit where most models have this rule is shot/charged from over 9"/6" away, pick one effect: the unit either gets +1 to Defense rolls, or enemy units get -1 to hit rolls against it. Note that you may pick a different effect each time the unit is attacked.

rules.name: Versatile Defense Aura
rules.description: This model's unit and up to 2 friendly units picked before the start of the game get Versatile Defense. If this model is killed, picked models that are deployed lose the rule.

spells.name: Brute Guts
spells.effect: Pick up to three friendly units within 18", which get Fearless once (next time the effect would apply).

spells.name: Devour Essence
spells.effect: Pick one enemy model within 18" in line of sight, which takes 2 hits with AP(1). This effect is resolved as if the target was a unit of [1].

spells.name: Great Psy-Maw
spells.effect: Pick one enemy unit within 18" in line of sight, which takes 6 hits with AP(2).

spells.name: Psychic Chains
spells.effect: Pick one enemy unit within 18" in line of sight, which gets Unwieldy on its weapons in melee once (next time the effect would apply).

spells.name: Psychic Feast
spells.effect: Pick up to two friendly units within 12", which get Spell Resistance once (next time the effect would apply).

spells.name: Trampling Force
spells.effect: Pick one enemy unit within 6", which takes 6 hits with Scourge.
